usage: A noun for the main stalk of a plant; it is the part that supports the leaves, flowers, or fruit.
Common in gardening and science talk; you will often hear it when people describe how a plant grows or where to cut it.
This word is neutral and natural in everyday speech, but in casual conversation people may simply say the plant part they mean instead of naming it.
For learners, the key point is that 花莖 refers to the stem of a plant, not a flower or leaf; it usually appears in plant descriptions, gardening, and biology lessons.
